title: "pILC MOFA2: Diagnostic Review of Gaussian-All Model"
output: html_document

This document evaluates the first exploratory MOFA2 Gaussian-all model.

The goal is to determine whether learned MOFA2 factors represent biological variation or technical/sample-availability structure caused by incomplete modality overlap.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

```{r}
OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2"

QC_DIR    <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "Sample_QC")
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Tables")
PLOT_DIR  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Plots")
DIAG_DIR  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Diagnostics")

dir.create(DIAG_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

FACTOR_FILE <- file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_scores_wide.csv")
PRESENCE_FILE <- file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_sample_view_presence_for_training.csv")
TOP_WEIGHT_FILE <- file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_top25_feature_weights_by_view_factor.csv")
```

```{r}
factor_dt <- fread(FACTOR_FILE)
presence_dt <- fread(PRESENCE_FILE)

cat("Factor score table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(factor_dt))

cat("Sample presence table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(presence_dt))

print(head(factor_dt))
print(head(presence_dt))
```
```{r}
# MOFA2 factor file usually has sample column named "sample"
# Rename to "Sample" for merging

if ("sample" %in% colnames(factor_dt)) {
  setnames(factor_dt, "sample", "Sample")
}

if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(factor_dt)) {
  stop("Could not find sample column in factor score table.")
}

if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(presence_dt)) {
  stop("Could not find Sample column in sample presence table.")
}

merged_dt <- merge(
  factor_dt,
  presence_dt,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

cat("Merged table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(merged_dt))

print(head(merged_dt))
```
```{r}
# Identify factor and modality columns
factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", colnames(merged_dt), value = TRUE)

# Modality columns are logical columns from sample presence file
non_modality_cols <- c("Sample", factor_cols, "N_views_present", "Keep_for_MOFA")
modality_cols <- setdiff(colnames(presence_dt), c("Sample", "N_views_present", "Keep_for_MOFA"))

cat("Factors:\n")
print(factor_cols)

cat("Modality presence columns:\n")
print(modality_cols)
```
```{r}
# Association between factors and number of available modalities

cor_results <- rbindlist(lapply(factor_cols, function(fac) {
  x <- merged_dt[[fac]]
  y <- merged_dt[["N_views_present"]]

  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  if (sum(ok) < 5) {
    return(data.table(
      Factor = fac,
      Test = "Spearman_N_views_present",
      Estimate = NA_real_,
      P_value = NA_real_,
      N = sum(ok)
    ))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))

  data.table(
    Factor = fac,
    Test = "Spearman_N_views_present",
    Estimate = unname(test$estimate),
    P_value = test$p.value,
    N = sum(ok)
  )
}))

cor_results[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  cor_results,
  file.path(DIAG_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_association_with_number_of_views.csv")
)

print(cor_results[order(P_value)])
```
```{r}
# Association between factors and modality availability
modality_results <- list()

k <- 1

for (fac in factor_cols) {
  for (mod in modality_cols) {
    
    x <- merged_dt[[fac]]
    g <- merged_dt[[mod]]
    
    ok <- is.finite(x) & !is.na(g)
    
    if (sum(ok) < 5 || length(unique(g[ok])) < 2) {
      modality_results[[k]] <- data.table(
        Factor = fac,
        Modality = mod,
        Test = "Wilcoxon_factor_by_modality_presence",
        Median_present = NA_real_,
        Median_absent = NA_real_,
        Difference_present_minus_absent = NA_real_,
        P_value = NA_real_,
        N_present = sum(g[ok] == TRUE),
        N_absent = sum(g[ok] == FALSE)
      )
      k <- k + 1
      next
    }
    
    test <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x[ok] ~ g[ok]))
    
    med_present <- median(x[ok][g[ok] == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    med_absent  <- median(x[ok][g[ok] == FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    modality_results[[k]] <- data.table(
      Factor = fac,
      Modality = mod,
      Test = "Wilcoxon_factor_by_modality_presence",
      Median_present = med_present,
      Median_absent = med_absent,
      Difference_present_minus_absent = med_present - med_absent,
      P_value = test$p.value,
      N_present = sum(g[ok] == TRUE),
      N_absent = sum(g[ok] == FALSE)
    )
    
    k <- k + 1
  }
}

modality_results <- rbindlist(modality_results)
modality_results[, FDR := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  modality_results,
  file.path(DIAG_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_association_with_modality_presence.csv")
)

print(modality_results[order(P_value)])
```
```{r}
# Plot factor scores by number of views present
for (fac in factor_cols) {
  
  p <- ggplot(
    merged_dt,
    aes(
      x = factor(N_views_present),
      y = .data[[fac]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(fac, " vs number of available modalities"),
      x = "Number of available modalities",
      y = paste0(fac, " score")
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(DIAG_DIR, paste0(fac, "_by_N_views_present.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
}
```
```{r}
# Plot factor scores by each modality presence
for (fac in factor_cols) {
  for (mod in modality_cols) {
    
    if (length(unique(na.omit(merged_dt[[mod]]))) < 2) next
    
    p <- ggplot(
      merged_dt,
      aes(
        x = factor(.data[[mod]], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
        y = .data[[fac]]
      )
    ) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste0(fac, " by ", mod, " availability"),
        x = paste0(mod, " available"),
        y = paste0(fac, " score")
      )
    
    print(p)
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(DIAG_DIR, paste0(fac, "_by_", mod, "_availability.pdf")),
      plot = p,
      width = 7,
      height = 5
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Diagnostic interpretation table
diagnostic_summary <- merge(
  cor_results[, .(
    Factor,
    Spearman_with_N_views = Estimate,
    P_N_views = P_value,
    FDR_N_views = FDR
  )],
  modality_results[
    order(P_value),
    .SD[1],
    by = Factor
  ][, .(
    Factor,
    Strongest_modality_presence_signal = Modality,
    Modality_presence_difference = Difference_present_minus_absent,
    P_modality_presence = P_value,
    FDR_modality_presence = FDR
  )],
  by = "Factor",
  all = TRUE
)

diagnostic_summary[, Potential_technical_factor := 
                     (FDR_N_views < 0.1) | (FDR_modality_presence < 0.1)]

fwrite(
  diagnostic_summary,
  file.path(DIAG_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_technical_diagnostic_summary.csv")
)

print(diagnostic_summary)
```
```{r}
# Interpretation guide

# Factors marked as `Potential_technical_factor = TRUE` should be interpreted cautiously, because they may partly reflect incomplete modality overlap or assay availability rather than biological variation.

# Factors not associated with modality availability are stronger candidates for downstream biological interpretation.

# Session info
sessionInfo()
```
